sampler.terrainUvFormula: u = x / (hexMapAspect * hexTerrainScale) + 0.5; v = y / hexTerrainScale + 0.5
sampler.pixelFormula: pixelX = clamp(round(u * (sourceWidth - 1)), 0, sourceWidth - 1); pixelY = clamp(round(v * (sourceHeight - 1)), 0, sourceHeight - 1)
sampler.mapOutsideRule: hex centers outside terrain UV [0, 1] are water / non-land

terrainSampler.matchRule: terrain = mountainTerrain when land && mountainColorHits >= mountainMinHits; otherwise fallbackTerrain

environmentSampler.matchRule: environment = forestEnvironment when land && forestColorHits >= forestMinHits; otherwise fallbackEnvironment
